Privacy policy

InvoiceFlow ZA — a local-first invoicing app for South African freelancers and small businesses.

Publisher: [[PUBLISHER NAME]] · Support: [[SUPPORT EMAIL]] · Effective: [[DATE]]

DRAFT — not ready to publish.Highlighted fields must be completed by the app owner before this page is used as the Google Play privacy policy URL. No publisher, support address or retention contact may be inferred or invented.

1. What this app stores on your device

Business details, customers, items, quotes, invoices, payments, expenses, any receipt attachments you add, your settings and any backups you create. This information is held in the app's private storage on your device. Android cloud backup is disabled for this app, so it is not copied into Android device backups.

2. What leaves your device

Only what you explicitly export or share. When you export a PDF, CSV or backup file, it is handed to the Android save or share destination you choose, and that destination handles it under its own terms. Your records are not transmitted to us automatically.

3. Network access

This app requests internet access because it loads its application content over HTTPS and can receive updates. [[REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLISHING: confirm against the release build that no analytics, crash-reporting or advertising SDK is present and that no unexpected network transfer occurs.]]

4. Permissions

Internet access only. The app does not request access to your photos, contacts, location, camera, microphone or all-files storage.

5. Security

Records stay in the app's private storage area. Backups you export can be password protected if you enable that option; keep the password separately, because a lost password cannot be recovered. Anyone using your unlocked device may be able to read records inside this app.

6. Retention and deletion

Your records remain on your device until you delete them, clear the app's storage or uninstall the app. We hold no copy to delete on your behalf. Export a backup before clearing app data or uninstalling, because Android backup is disabled for this app.

7. Children

This is a business tool and is not directed at children. [[REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLISHING: confirm this matches the Play target-audience declaration.]]

8. Changes

This policy will be updated, with its effective date, if these practices change. [[REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLISHING: state how users are told about changes.]]

9. Contact

Questions about this policy or your data: [[SUPPORT EMAIL]].
